retrievalProfile.description: A playful mid-century aesthetic combining a realistic grayscale portrait head with a flat, stylized illustrated body and background.
excludeWhen: realistic lighting and shadows are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A whimsical composition featuring a large grayscale photographic head of a smiling man grafted onto a small, flatly illustrated jockey body. The scene includes a stylized horse with geometric limbs and floral accents, set against a clean white background with bold, colorful typographic blocks.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the oversized realistic head and the diminutive illustrated body
Juxtaposition of grayscale photography against a vibrant, flat-color palette
Alignment of text blocks along the left margin balancing the central character
Integration of hand-drawn floral elements with geometric animal shapes
coreInvariants: Flat, unshaded color fields for illustration

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central character with an oversized head dominates the middle-right; horse spans the width behind the character.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large grayscale face acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large head, moves up to the bold title, then down the left-hand list of colorful text blocks.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space surrounding the central collage elements provides a clean, modern feel.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Burnt orange and muted blue for primary illustrated shapes
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow, pink, and brown used in the secondary text blocks
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-contrast values in the photo; medium-saturation, matte colors in the illustration.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended, heavy sans-serif with geometric foundations
letterConstructionRules: Slightly rounded corners on heavy strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: S and G have very open apertures
Lower-case letters are italicized and thick
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pairing a massive, extended uppercase header with a smaller, bold italic lowercase sub-header and a list of multi-colored block-aligned text.
graphicDevices: Solid color rectangular backgrounds for text
Abstracted grass line at the bottom

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century industrial feel and extreme width.
Captures the heavy weight and distinctive retro curves.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a flat-color illustration of a stylized horse and a tiny jockey body in a 1950s gouache style. Leave a gap for a head. Add a grayscale photographic head of a smiling person on top of the jockey body. Use a clean cream background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold, extra-extended sans-serif text in burnt orange at the top. Add a vertical list of text on the left, each line with a different flat-color rectangular background.

verificationChecks: Is the head photographic and grayscale?
Is the body illustrated and flat-colored?
Is the header text extremely wide and bold?
Is the background a solid, off-white color?

adjustableVariables: Number of text blocks in the sidebar
Specific hue of the header text
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or song titles
The specific facial identity of the subject

mustAchieve: Hand-painted texture on the illustrated parts
Clean, sharp edges on the photo-cutout

postGenerationChecks: Check for flat color consistency in the illustration
Ensure the photo-to-illustration transition is sharp and intentional
Verify the typography is extended and heavy
Confirm the background is free of complex textures
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Grayscale Portrait Head] + [Flat Gouache Body Illustration] + [Extended Bold Sans-Serif Typography] + [Multi-colored Text Blocks] on a [Cream Background].
